prompt.key: The password of the guest's user, kept in the keychain: omaflake creates macOS bases with it and builds macOS images with it (sudo), so you never type it there; it never goes into an image. Copy it from here whenever a guest asks.
prompt.text: The password of the guest's user, kept in the keychain: omaflake creates macOS bases with it and builds macOS images with it (sudo), so you never type it there; it never goes into an image. Copy it from here whenever a guest asks.

help.key: Only for you – to tell your credentials apart in the lists and when building.
help.text: Only for you – to tell your credentials apart in the lists and when building.

help.key: NixOS: the login user – the automatic login, the home folder /home/<user> and omaf ssh. macOS: the user of a base created with it.
help.text: NixOS: the login user – the automatic login, the home folder /home/<user> and omaf ssh. macOS: the user of a base created with it.

help.key: NixOS: the account's description and git's user.name. macOS: the account's name in a base created with it.
help.text: NixOS: the account's description and git's user.name. macOS: the account's name in a base created with it.

help.key: NixOS: git's user.email; may stay empty. Not used in macOS guests.
help.text: NixOS: git's user.email; may stay empty. Not used in macOS guests.

intro.key: Who you are in a guest. NixOS images take the user, full name and e-mail; a macOS base is created with the user, full name and password. The password – asked once, here – is kept in the keychain: omaflake uses it for macOS bases and builds, and you can copy it whenever a guest asks.
